text:
Matt: Heads-up: planning a soft unpin of runtime-2.14 for quantized-model-pool tonight 23:00 PST. We validated kv-cache fix in canary and p95 token latency is down ~12%.

Matt: Intent is soft-unpin (regional rollout + telemetry) rather than full unpin to avoid churn.

Alina: SGTM. What are explicit rollback triggers? We should be concrete so oncall can act quickly.

Matt: Rollback triggers: sustained error rate >5% for 5m, any OOMs on pods serving >100qps, or memory growth >20% vs baseline for 10m.

Jordan: QA found an edgecase: with certain longseq prompts generation stalls (~5/500 requests). Repro with seed=42 locally. Not frequent but we should capture examples.

Matt: Can we avoid re-pinning by adding a lightweight retry-and-warmup shim for the longseq case?

Sam: I prefer a retry shim too. Also propose region gating: keep eu-west on pinned runtime 2.13 for a 6h safety window.

Lee: In staging I ran a soft-unpin config that worked: 
```
route_rules:
  - match: /models/quant-*
    runtime: 2.14
    soft_unpin: true
    fallback_runtime: 2.13
    rollout: regional(75%)
```

deploybot: unpin-request logged by Matt at 2799998881. Canaries: canary-quant-1, canary-quant-2. Scheduled change: 2026-03-21T23:00:00-08:00.

Alina: Can we add a telemetry flag to surface stalled prompt hashes + truncated prompt snippets + first-token latency? That will speed triage.

Jordan: I'll add a lightweight eval to capture {hash, input_len, first_token_latency, seed} and push in ~10m. Will attach a filter to only store examples that hit the stall pattern.

Sam: Note for oncall: @oncall-eng-runtime please monitor canary-quant* for 1h post-change and escalate to #eng-releases if any rollback trigger fires.

Lee: Operational rule: if any degraded LLM outputs are detected, fallback to 2.13 must be immediate (no phased ramp). Also allow manual pinlist hold for up to 2h after incident.

Matt: Agreed. I'll keep the pinlist open for 2h post-change and post status updates. EU region will remain pinned for 6h. Telemetry capture enabled, immediate fallback runtime is 2.13 on trigger.

ci-bot: Preflight checks: smoke ✅, perf ✅, kv-cache regression ✅ — 8/8 checks passed.

Matt: Final: proceeding at 23:00 PST. Leaving runbook here: 1) kick soft-unpin rollout, 2) enable telemetry flag, 3) monitor triggers, 4) immediate fallback to 2.13 on trigger, 5) if we see recurring stalls, abort and open a deeper investigation with logs and KV traces.

Alina: Ack. Standing by.

oncall-eng-runtime: Oncall acked. Will take alert ownership for the 1h watch window and will post updates to #eng-releases channel if anything notable appears.

Matt: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Jordan: pushed eval change and a small metric for stalled_count per-canary. Should start reporting within 2m.

Lee: leaving this config in case we need to roll back quickly: `deploy revert --route models/quant-* --runtime 2.13 --force`

Matt: documented in release notes draft: "soft-unpin runtime-2.14 for quantized pool; telemetry enabled; EU pinned for 6h; fallback to 2.13 on error triggers." Will finalize after the window.
